description: Known-failure baseline for the nightly workflow (.github/workflows/nightly.yml). Nightly is green iff the soak FAIL names and manifest MISMATCH messages exactly match the multisets below (order does not matter, counts and duplicates do). A new failure OR a healed known failure turns nightly red via tools/nightly-baseline-check.mjs. To update deliberately: run `npm run test:sim` and `npm run verify:manifests` on a verified-good main, capture the FAIL names (detail after ' -- ' stripped) and MISMATCH messages (text after 'MISMATCH '), replace the arrays below, keep the fixtures under tools/fixtures/nightly-baseline/ in sync, run `node tools/nightly-baseline-check.mjs --self-test`, and review the diff like code. Captured on origin/main 3948e89, 2026-10-20.
